subtitle: When kings fell at Koppam, the river of war for Vengi kept flowing

panels.shot: epic split-composition, two armies facing across a broad river plain
panels.action: Someshvara I and Rajadhiraja Chola stand on opposite banks of a wide southern river, each in full royal war attire, armies stretching behind them into the hazy distance.

dialogue.text: At Koppam, Rajadhiraja Chola fell from his elephant, yet both Cholas and Chalukyas carved victory into stone. Who truly won the war for Vengi?

i18n.hi: कोप्पम में राजाधिराज चोल हाथी से गिरा, फिर भी चोल और चालुक्य दोनों ने पत्थर पर जीत खोदी। तो सच में वेंगी की जंग कौन जीता?

panels.shot: slow push-in over a map-like aerial view
panels.action: A painted map of peninsular India shows the Krishna-Godavari delta glowing rich green between Kanchipuram in the south and Kalyani in the Deccan.

dialogue.text: Between the Krishna and the Godavari lay Vengi, a fertile delta of rice and canals. For a century, Cholas and Chalukyas reached for it like two hands for one jewel.

i18n.hi: कृष्णा और गोदावरी के बीच थी वेंगी, धान और नहरों की उपजाऊ डेल्टा। सौ साल से चोल और चालुक्य इसे ऐसे छीने जैसे दो हाथ एक ही रत्न पर भिड़ें।

panels.action: On one side Rajadhiraja Chola sits in his war camp near Kanchipuram, armored, studying palm-leaf records; on the other Someshvara I in Kalyani consults ministers under a stone pavilion.

dialogue.text: Rajadhiraja Chola, heir to Rajendra, saw Vengi as his eastern shield. Someshvara I of Kalyani saw it as his gateway to the sea. Neither could afford to let go.

i18n.hi: राजेन्द्र का उत्तराधिकारी राजाधिराज चोल वेंगी को अपना पूर्वी कवच मानता था। कल्याणी के सोमेश्वर प्रथम के लिए वही सागर का द्वार था। कोई इसे छोड़ने को तैयार नहीं था।

panels.shot: wide shot of marriage ceremony as a flashback tableau
panels.action: A royal wedding scene in Vengi shows a Chola prince joining hands with an Eastern Chalukya princess, flanked by solemn courtiers from both dynasties.

dialogue.text: For years, Eastern Chalukya kings of Vengi balanced between Kalyani and the Cholas, sealing bonds by marriage. These ties made brothers and rivals in the same breath.

i18n.hi: सालों तक वेंगी के पूर्वी चालुक्य राजा कल्याणी और चोलों के बीच झूलते रहे, शादी से रिश्ते जोड़े। वही बंधन भाई भी बनाते, दुश्मन भी।

panels.shot: documentary-style close-up on inscriptions being carved
panels.action: Stone masons carve bold Chola Tamil letters on one slab while, in parallel, artisans carve Kannada Nagari on another, both slabs shown side by side.

dialogue.text: In Tamil and Kannada, inscriptions sang of conquest. Yet when Chola stones claimed Vengi, Chalukya stones answered from the Deccan. Words fought as hard as spears.

i18n.hi: तमिल और कन्नड़ में शिलालेख जीत का गान गाते रहे। चोल पत्थर वेंगी पर दावा करते, तो चालुक्य पत्थर दक्कन से जवाब देते। शब्द भी भालों जितना जोर से भिड़े।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Rajadhiraja on war elephant leading columns
panels.action: Rajadhiraja Chola rides a towering war elephant across a dusty plain, mail shirt gleaming, with disciplined Chola infantry and cavalry streaming past temple-tanks and fields.

dialogue.text: Rajadhiraja marched north, past Kanchipuram and into the Andhra plains, pushing deep into Someshvara’s sphere. Chola records boast of burning forts and seizing banners.

i18n.hi: राजाधिराज उत्तर चला, कांचीपुरम पार कर आंध्र के मैदानों में, सोमेश्वर के दायरे के बीचोंबीच। चोल लेख आग में सुलगे किले और छिने ध्वज गिनाते हैं।

panels.shot: dramatic wide of Someshvara on a fortress rampart
panels.action: Someshvara I stands atop a stone fort wall in the Deccan, looking south, armored but calm, as couriers and generals cluster below with reports.

dialogue.text: Someshvara I did not rush blindly. From Kalyani he tested Chola reach, striking at allies, measuring the cost of confronting a power that now touched the Tungabhadra.

i18n.hi: सोमेश्वर प्रथम ने जल्दबाज़ी नहीं की। कल्याणी से उसने चोलों की पहुँच परखते हुए उनके साथियों पर वार किया, उस ताकत की कीमत नापी जो अब तुंगभद्रा तक फैल चुकी थी।

panels.shot: tense mid-shot of both commanders studying terrain, intercut
panels.action: Intercut images show Rajadhiraja and Someshvara each with commanders, pointing at river-banks and fields on rough maps, the word 'Koppam' etched on a wooden tablet between them.

dialogue.text: Near the Tungabhadra, at Koppam, their paths bent toward each other. Each king believed this battle could bend the history of Vengi itself.

i18n.hi: तुंगभद्रा के पास, कोप्पम में, उनकी राहें एक-दूसरे की ओर मुड़ गईं। हर राजा मानता था कि ये लड़ाई खुद वेंगी के इतिहास को मोड़ सकती है।

panels.shot: epic wide battlefield establishing shot at dawn
panels.action: At dawn, two vast armies face off across uneven scrubby ground by a river, standards of the tiger and the Varaha fluttering, elephants restless, dust beginning to rise.

dialogue.text: The Chola tiger banners met Chalukya emblems by the river. Chola accounts remember Rajadhiraja fighting atop an elephant, royal yet exposed above the crush.

i18n.hi: नदी के किनारे चोल के शेर वाले ध्वज चालुक्य चिन्हों से भिड़े। चोल कथाएँ राजाधिराज को हाथी पर लड़ते याद रखती हैं, रुई समान शाही पर ऊपर से खुला निशाना।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-shot focused on Rajadhiraja on elephant amidst melee
panels.action: Rajadhiraja stands high on his elephant in mid-battle, arm raised in command, while archers and spearmen surge around; Someshvara’s lines press in the distance.

dialogue.speaker: someshvara_i_and_rajadhiraja_chola
dialogue.text: Hold the line. Vengi watches us today.

i18n.hi: पंक्ति मत टूटने दो। वेंगी आज हमें देख रही है।

panels.shot: sudden dramatic close-up of Rajadhiraja losing balance
panels.action: In a frozen instant amidst chaos, Rajadhiraja’s body tilts backward on the elephant’s howdah, eyes wide, as the beast rears; the battlefield blurs around him.

dialogue.text: Then, in the dust and noise, Rajadhiraja fell. Chola inscriptions themselves admit it: their king died on the field, breaking the pride of his army for a breath.

i18n.hi: फिर धूल और शोर के बीच राजाधिराज गिर पड़ा। खुद चोल लेख मानते हैं: उनका राजा मैदान में ही मारा गया, एक पल को सेना का अभिमान टूट गया।

panels.shot: heroic low-angle of Rajendra II rallying troops
panels.action: Another Chola prince, Rajendra II, climbs onto the same elephant, gripping the side and raising his sword, as shaken soldiers turn their faces up to him.

dialogue.text: But that breath did not last. Rajendra II seized the fallen king’s place, rallied the broken ranks, and Chola records declare that the day was theirs at Koppam.

i18n.hi: पर वो पल टिक नहीं पाया। राजेन्द्र द्वितीय ने गिरे राजा की जगह संभाली, टूटी कतारें संभालीं, और चोल लेखों ने दिन को कोप्पम में अपना बता दिया।

panels.shot: somber mid-shot of Chalukya scribes in a temple hall
panels.action: Chalukya scribes kneel in a dark temple hall, chiseling a new inscription on Someshvara’s orders, while a priest watches; warriors stand tired but upright nearby.

dialogue.text: Yet from Tambarasa and Jainad, Chalukya stones speak otherwise: they praise Someshvara’s arms, claim victory, and insist that the Chola advance was checked.

i18n.hi: पर तम्बरसा और जैनाड से चालुक्य पत्थर अलग बात कहते हैं: वे सोमेश्वर की बाहों की तारीफ करते, जीत का दावा ठोंकते, और कहते कि चोलों की चढ़ाई वहीँ रुक गई।

panels.shot: close-up on two inscriptions facing each other
panels.action: Two stone slabs stand opposite in a gallery—one Tamil Chola, one Kannada Chalukya—each weathered, each with proud lines about Koppam and Vengi.

dialogue.text: So historians read stone against stone. K.A. Nilakanta Sastri weighs the Chola boasts; B.R. Gopal reads Chalukya claims. Victory shifts with the eye that reads.

i18n.hi: तो इतिहासकार पत्थर से पत्थर पढ़कर भिड़ते हैं। के. ए. नीलकंठ शास्त्री चोल शेखी तौलते हैं; बी. आर. गोपाल चालुक्य दावे पढ़ते हैं। किसकी जीत है, नज़र बदलते ही बदल जाती है।

panels.shot: muted interior shot of Chola court in mourning
panels.action: In the Chola court, courtiers in silk and armor stand with heads bowed; Rajendra II sits on the throne, a royal umbrella above, but the space around him feels heavy.

dialogue.text: Whatever the outcome on the ground, Rajadhiraja was gone. The Chola world had to mourn a king, crown another, and still pretend in stone that nothing had been lost.

i18n.hi: जमीन पर जो भी नतीजा रहा हो, राजाधिराज चला गया था। चोल जगत को एक राजा शोक करना था, दूसरे को ताज देना था, और पत्थर पर फिर भी दिखाना था कि कुछ नहीं खोया।

panels.shot: wide shot of Someshvara in council planning further campaigns
panels.action: Someshvara I confers with generals and ministers, pointing to routes toward Vengi and coastal towns on a cloth map spread over a carved table.

dialogue.text: Someshvara could not fix Vengi with a single battle either. The delta lay far from Kalyani; each march there stretched his lines and opened flank and frontier.

i18n.hi: सोमेश्वर भी एक ही जंग से वेंगी को नहीं बाँध सका। वो डेल्टा कल्याणी से दूर थी; वहाँ हर चढ़ाई उसकी रेखाएँ खींच देती, किनारे और मोर्चे खुल जाते।

panels.shot: montage wide shot spanning decades of different banners over Vengi fields
panels.action: A time-lapse style tableau shows the same lush Vengi rice fields under changing royal camps: Chola tents, Chalukya horse-lines, then other standards, coming and going.

dialogue.text: After Koppam, Vikramaditya VI would campaign, Kulottunga I would rise with Eastern Chalukya blood, and Vengi’s fields saw banners change again and again.

i18n.hi: कोप्पम के बाद विक्रमादित्य षष्ठम ने मुहिमें चलाईं, कुलोत्तुंग प्रथम पूर्वी चालुक्य रक्त लेकर उठा, और वेंगी के खेतों ने फिर-फिर ध्वज बदलते देखे।

panels.shot: intimate mid-shot of villagers in Vengi working canals
panels.action: Farmers in Vengi repair irrigation channels and guide water into paddies, while, far off on the horizon, faint silhouettes of marching troops pass.

dialogue.text: For the people of Vengi, war meant new tax men, new coin, new orders on old land. Inscriptions screamed of victory; the canals asked only for steady hands.

i18n.hi: वेंगी के लोगों के लिए जंग का मतलब था नए कर-वसूलने वाले, नई मुद्राएँ, पुराने खेतों पर नए हुक्म। शिलालेख जीत चिल्लाते रहे; नहरों को बस स्थिर हाथों की चिंता थी।

panels.shot: quiet close-up on weathered faces carved in stone reliefs
panels.action: Carved stone reliefs of royal figures, worn smooth by time, stare out from a temple wall, their names faint; below, the river flows on in the background.

dialogue.text: Koppam shows us this: a king can die and still have his side claim triumph; an inscription can shout of conquest while the land itself stays contested and unsatisfied.

i18n.hi: कोप्पम हमें ये दिखाता है: राजा मर सकता है, फिर भी उसका पक्ष खुद को विजेता बता सकता है; शिलालेख फ़तह गरज सकते हैं, जबकि जमीन खुद झगड़े में उलझी, नाखुश बनी रहती है।

title_i18n.en: Koppam and the War for Vengi

subtitle_i18n.en: When kings fell at Koppam, the river of war for Vengi kept flowing
subtitle_i18n.hi: कोप्पम में राजा गिरे, पर वेंगी की जंग की नदी बहती रही
